org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

repo.description: `owner/repo`, lowercased. Empty string when the sender omitted it.

branch.description: The branch the run or commit belongs to.

workflow_name.description: The workflow that failed and then passed.

workflow_path.description: The workflow definition's repo-relative path — the stable identity a display name does not give you. Null when unreported.

failed_outcome_id.description: Id of the failing CI outcome.

fixed_outcome_id.description: Id of the passing CI outcome.

recovery_diff.description: The unified diff from the failing commit to the fixing one.

failed_inference_call_ids.description: Inference calls attributed to the failing commit.

fixed_inference_call_ids.description: Inference calls attributed to the fixing commit.

provenance.description: The structured provenance for this artifact.

failed_attribution_evidence.description: Optional failed-side enrichment source records, ordered by Inference call and Session ID.

fixed_attribution_evidence.description: Optional fixed-side enrichment source records, ordered by Inference call and Session ID.

repository_identity.description: Qualified provider, host, and repository ID; null for an unambiguous legacy repository.

quarantine_revision.description: The integer quarantine-log high-water mark used for the derivation.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 of the fully resolved derivation policy when available.

inference_call_id.description: Id of the inference call this record belongs to.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

attribution_sources.description: Sorted distinct Attribution methods for this enrichment call on this side's commit.

session_commit_observation_ids.description: Sorted unique observation IDs matching this enrichment Session and this side's qualified commit.

provider.description: The forge provider that assigns the immutable repository ID.

repository_id.description: Immutable provider repository ID within its forge host.
